text:
maya: heads up: p99 latency jumped from ~120ms -> ~1.1s across multiple pods after last model rollout (~2h ago). spikes started ~10m after rollout.
sam: looking now — is this the new tokenizer variant? which model version?
maya: yes v2.3.1 with the trimmed-split tokenizer. traffic % rollout was 20% but we're seeing replicated latency in dedicated pools too.
jon: grabbing traces. root cause candidate: KV cache miss rate spiked. profiler shows KV cache hit down from 86% -> 41% for long-context sessions.
sasha: that tokenization change would change prefix alignment, killing prefix reuse. i ran a quick diff: input "The quick brown fox" old tok -> [The, quick, brown, fox] new tok -> [The, qui, ck, ▁brown, ▁fox] — prefixes diverge.
sam: can you paste the kernel selection logs? maybe sequence length distribution changed and we picked an inefficient kernel path.
jon: paste below (snip):
```
[2026-03-17T12:11:05Z] kernel_select: model=v2.3.1 seq_len=256 median_seq=34 choice=matmul_fused_v2 (fallback)
[2026-03-17T12:11:06Z] kernel_select: model=v2.2.9 seq_len=256 median_seq=34 choice=streamed_attention_opt (expected)
```
jon: so rollout ended up choosing matmul_fused_v2 for many requests; that's higher latency for our typical short median_seq workload.
maya: perf-bot reported a small change in seq length distribution after rollout too.
perf-bot: summary: median tokens/request before=28 after=38, 95th shifted right by ~12 tokens, tail heavier. KV cache reuse rate correlates with token alignment changes from tokenizer.
ops-bot: host metrics: noisy neighbor on gpu-host-22 between 12:09-12:18 — GPU SM utilization oscillated, context switching high. IO wait briefly elevated.
sam: so two simultaneous degradations: tokenizer changes reduce KV reuse + noisy neighbor exacerbates kernel latency. that explains big p99 jump.
sasha: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback tokenizer change for rollout, 2) force kernel override to streamed_attention_opt for short seqs, 3) bump batcher timeout to allow better batching while we investigate.
jon: kernel override test: i set KERNEL_OVERRIDE=streamed_attention_opt on a canary pod and reran load. p50 ~125ms p99 ~180ms (much better).
maya: great — can we flip override for the fleet while we get a proper fix? impact on cost minimal for now.
ops-bot: deployed kernel override at 12:32 to 20% traffic, then to 100% at 12:40. p99 dropped back near baseline within 2 mins for most clusters.
sam: follow-ups: ticket perf-789 to track tokenizer changes + KV heuristics, root-cause doc, and schedule deeper profiling to determine why kernel selector favored matmul_fused_v2 (maybe metric thresholds).
sasha: I'll add a unit for tokenizer regression tests comparing token alignment and KV-reuse score. also add a rollout gate: KV-reuse delta < 5% allowed.
jon: adding full perf trace snippets to the ticket (nvprof + runtime traces). short sample:
```
NVPROF: kernel: attention_fused time=1.2ms calls=3400
NVPROF: kernel: matmul_fused_v2 time=3.6ms calls=1900
```
maya: note: noisy neighbor was real — ops to check tenant scheduling on gpu-host-22 and add anti-affinity for critical pools.
ops-bot: created infra ticket infra-452 (anti-affinity + tighter placement).
sam: temporary action items done: kernel override rolled, rollout paused, rollback not needed. longterm: adjust kernel selection thresholds, improve tokenizer gating, and add KV-reuse monitoring to release dashboard.
maya: thanks all — if anyone sees residual spikes tag me. i'll shepherd the follow-ups. :thumbsup:
